cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Gaziev is fat, badly beaten up in his last two fights and likely to quit if it goes long; Nzechukwu is younger, less damaged and lives healthier — take the moneyline.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: His 'plus money dog' — Gaziev's gas tank is poor and he's sloppy on the feet, while Nzechukwu is more technical with decent takedown defense and should take over late.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Gaziev's cardio can't handle extended fights and he doubts the wrestling sticks past round one; Nzechukwu's volume, shot selection and body kicks should let him take over in rounds two and three.

cappers.name: Pure Picks MMA
cappers.reasoning: Gaziev struggled badly against Rozenstruik when he couldn't get the fight to the mat, and Nzechukwu is durable, hard to take down and can piece him up from the outside with length and power.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Leg of the +3327 parlay, admitted it's the scariest leg, but expects Gaziev to gas by the third round and Nzechukwu to land something big and finish him.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He sees Nzechukwu landing straight shots and finding a late finish, probably in the third, once Gaziev tires.

options.selection: Shamil Gaziev by KO in round 1

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Gaziev is dangerous for the first few minutes and Nzechukwu's chin and consistency can't be trusted; he repeatedly says he doesn't feel good about the pick.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Called his 'savage underdog lock' — Rodrigues hits like a truck and he doesn't see Hernandez surviving that power or easily getting takedowns, expecting a first or second round finish.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: He's never been an Anthony Hernandez guy; Rodriguez's power (accidental KO of Bruno Ferreira) should smash Hernandez if the fight is contested standing.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Picks Hernandez to win the main event.

options.selection: Anthony Hernandez by TKO in the late rounds

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Official prediction is a late-rounds ground and pound TKO for Hernandez, whose gas tank advantage should let him drag Rodrigues into deep water past the first round and a half.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He doesn't see the fight reaching round three and predicts Rodrigues touches Hernandez's chin for a second round knockout.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Paired with Rodriguez's moneyline for +252 — if Rodriguez wins he thinks it comes inside 3.5 rounds and doesn't expect a late finish.

options.selection: Gregory Rodrigues by KO in round 1 or 2

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Hernandez chose to box Strickland and shot no takedowns, and Rodrigues hits harder with two rounds of cardio; if it reaches round three Hernandez takes over.

options.selection: Gregory Rodrigues by KO in rounds 1-2

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: He names this as one of the two best plays on the fight because of Rodrigues' power and devastating early body shots against a Hernandez who is susceptible to the body.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Leg of the +110 two-leg parlay; McVey has improved a lot since the amateur loss years ago, should stop Schultz's takedowns, win the clinch with knees and elbows, and possibly finish him.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: McVey is bigger and younger and the loss to Schultz was long ago; Schultz has shown no improvement, but Sam stated low confidence and wrote down no prop.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: He won't pick Schultz to win again despite the grappling edge; McVey hits hard and has solid finishing ability on the feet and ground.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He sees McVey landing a knee or elbow from the clinch to put Schultz down.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: McVey is the bigger, better striker with more finishing ability on the ground; Schultz's wrestling hasn't translated at UFC level.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects a hectic first round with either a McVey finish or a Schultz submission, so he leans an under 1.5 rounds / no-round-two type prop depending on price.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Calls it an easy pick: Douglas is a powerhouse with strong calf kicks and Emmers is outmatched.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Emmers stays in the pocket and got clipped by Hyder Amil; Douglas is much faster and hits far too hard for that.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Douglas is one of the hardest hitters in the division with short compact power shots, Emmers was stumbled by a lesser striker, and he agrees with the odds in a high-paced first round.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects Douglas to establish low kicks then crack Emmers upstairs for an early first-or-second-round finish.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Thinks the under 1.5 at -155 is better value than Douglas round-one KO or the -215 KO price, since Emmers' wrestling could extend round one slightly.

options.selection: Le'Veon Douglas by KO in round 1 or 2

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Calls Douglas the hardest hitting featherweight on the roster and believes he's fixed his issues with pressure; warns Emmers' pressure and takedowns are the risk.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: He'll put a decent-sized play on Petrino's moneyline: he hits harder, moves better, throws cleaner combinations and could even get control time with offensive wrestling.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Leaning Petrino because he has more power and pop, solid takedown defense (stuffed Thomas Petersen) and won't be outworked on the feet.

cappers.name: Pure Picks MMA
cappers.reasoning: Petrino is flaky and untrustworthy (losses to Anthony Smith and Jacoby, nearly finished by Aslund), while Spivak has far more heavyweight experience, strong wrestling and improved striking.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Petrino hits far too hard for Spivak's jab-based game and heavyweights don't get up well off their back; only risk is Petrino needlessly wrestling into a guillotine.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects Petrino to win by KO.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects Petrino to unload a big combination and put Spivac out, calling a second round KO.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Dyer has the better, slicker kickboxing and range control while Reed is unimpressive on the feet and will be a step behind all fight.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Dyer is taller, rangier, faster and the better counter striker, and Reed leaves herself very open on the feet with her chin high; but he calls the big favorite price a disgrace and warns not to parlay the fight heavily.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Dyer is the better striker and Reed has three KO losses and has been finished recently; her better wins are years old.

options.selection: Chanel Dyer by KO in round 2

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Dyer is the bigger, more powerful striker with a kickboxing/Muay Thai base and good volume; he expects her to catch Reed, likely to the body, like she did against Ravena Oliveira.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects Dyer to pick Reed apart and eventually land a finishing shot, calling it a second round finish.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Wint just demolished Matt Adams on Contender Series and Chapman is a low-output, unimpressive striker.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Part of his Wint moneyline + under 1.5 rounds parlay; Wint probably wins and any knockout likely comes in the first seven and a half minutes, though he's small for heavyweight and the price isn't exciting.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Combined with Wint's moneyline at -228; knockout chances drop off dramatically in the second half of a heavyweight fight once both men tire.

options.selection: Anthony Wint by KO in round 1

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Wint just won on Contender Series taking no damage and has quick KO power; Chapman shies away when punches come at him.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects Wint to blitz Chapman and get another quick first round finish.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Haqparast is damaged and beaten up after years of decisions and a recent head kick KO, while Padilla is on a five-fight UFC run and has a significantly better MMA mind; Padilla is the slam of the week for the price.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Odds are dead even; Padilla's pressure, pace and power can replicate what Ribovics and Gordon did to Haqparast, who is coming off damaging fights and a bad KO loss.

cappers.name: Pure Picks MMA
cappers.reasoning: Haqparast's recent wins were close/split decisions he could have lost and he gets hit a lot, while Padilla is durable, high-volume with nasty elbows, knees and kicks and good cardio for three rounds; sees him winning by decision or TKO.

options.selection: Chris Padilla inside the distance (KO or submission)

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Haqparast's chin is compromised and Padilla fights smart in every realm; +290 inside the distance is worth laying money on.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects accumulated damage to tell late, with Padilla hunting a hurt Haqparast down, or otherwise a decision.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Judice's slick kickboxing, speed and range management are too much for the power-loading Chavez.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Judice is the better striker with more volume but has won the vast majority of her UFC fights by decision, and Chavez is incredibly tough and won't quit; he sees a damage-based decision.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He sees Judice picking Chavez apart from distance for 15 minutes and winning on the cards.

options.selection: Carli Judice to win, over 1.5 rounds

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Leg of the +103 two-leg parlay; Judice is the far superior kickboxer with better range management and should pick Chavez apart to a decision rather than an early finish.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Jones is a savage with a reach advantage who should out-tough Madeiros, as shown in his war with Axel Solar.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Leg of a +110 two-leg parlay; Jones's constant pressure and cage-cutting will wear down an opponent who wants to fight at range, leading to a late finish or decision.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: At +500 he loves it: if Jones gets the rangy striker Madeiros down he can submit him.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Trembley started MMA late, has faced nobody of note and mostly submits opponents, while Puga is a young Mexican knockout artist who has never been submitted.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Puga is a legitimate boxing threat with striking finishes; Sam said he'll take the KO if it's plus money.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Called Perez the lock of the card — far more skilled, showed the real deal against Manuel Sosa, while Paxton is a meat-and-potatoes wrestler who's beaten only tin cans.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Perez is far more skilled and should cook Paxton, whose only path is takedowns and ground and pound.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Young has 14 pro fights versus Dosainvil's six, and Young's volume should add up against Dosainvil's poor defense; expects a close decision.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Brito is battle tested against real European competition while Fazil has been can crushing on a much weaker circuit; the fake tough guy act at the faceoff flipped Sam onto Brito.

fights.display: Reinier de Ridder vs Roman Dolidze

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Dolidze is done at this point and will fade once things stop going his way; de Ridder is the bigger, undrained A-side, so don't get cute with props, just take him straight.
